description: Agent slot record for one GEO position. Same payload as clarke_get_slot: operatorMix as the occupancy identity, FCC rows, disputes, ituRecorded, and source vintage including tleStale (older than 45 days). operatorIdentity split means the window is shared. ITU filings are not in this product. ITU Space Explorer is the current ITU source. SNS Online shut down in January 2025 (ituRecorded is not_in_product). TLE longitude is a tracked position, not an FCC or ITU assignment.
name: clarke_get_terminal
